Export lists of records (models) tracked in the inventory as comma-delimited tables (`.csv`).

::: {.attn}

## Prerequisites

- [x] {{< var link.login >}}
- [x] There are records registered in the inventory.[^1]

:::

## Export lists of records

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa cubes >}} Inventory**.

2. (Optional) Narrow down and organize the list of records and column headers you want to export by:

    - Filtering and sorting records[^2]
    - Toggling visibility of and reordering column headers[^3]

3. Click **{{< fa ellipsis >}} More** and select **{{< fa download >}} Export**.

4. In the Export Inventory dialog, choose which columns the file includes:

    - **The N columns in the table** — The columns currently shown in your table, in the same order. This is the default.
    - **All N fields** — Every field available in Manage Columns. The columns in your table come first, followed by the remaining fields.

    Your choice applies to this export only. Exporting all fields does not add them to your table.

5. Click **Export**.

    A `.csv` file with your filters, search, and sorting applied is downloaded automatically. To close the dialog without exporting, click **Cancel**.

When you export from an inventory segment, the file downloads right away with the segment's columns, without the Export Inventory dialog.[^4]


<!-- FOOTNOTES -->

[^1]: [Register records in the inventory](/guide/inventory/register-records-in-inventory.qmd)

[^2]: [Working with the inventory](/guide/inventory/working-with-the-inventory.qmd#search-filter-and-sort-records)

[^3]: [Customize inventory layout](/guide/inventory/customize-inventory-layout.qmd#customize-table-view)

[^4]: [Manage inventory segments](/guide/inventory/manage-inventory-segments.qmd)
